title: Career and the question of a job change
subtitle: A sample report on an invented person, Asha. Not a real chart.

engine.calculation: local Swiss Ephemeris (Lahiri, mean nodes, whole-sign houses)
notes: Dasha dates use sidereal years (365.256 days); programs that count 360-day years give earlier dates.
Planet strength figures are the engine's Shadbala ratios (strength divided by the minimum required).

summary.headline: Work in this chart is built on steady service and effort. A job change fits 2027 better than the last weeks of 2026: use the coming months to prepare and look around, and expect the clearer opening between June and October 2027.

key_points.text: A working life built on skill, service and steady effort rather than sudden luck; Jupiter and Saturn both support it, and Mars, the ruler of the work house, is the strongest planet by the engine's measure.

With Jupiter entering Leo and Rahu changing sign, the next three months bring conversations and possibly offers, but the terms are likely to be unclear. Preparing and exploring suits this stretch better than signing and leaving.
The clearer opening for a move comes when Saturn enters Aries and Jupiter returns to Leo; it can be delayed or partly reversed when Saturn steps back in October.
A change of long chapter begins in January 2028, when Saturn's period starts: a longer-lasting, more responsible phase of work.
Income follows skill and service steadily; negotiating the pay is the weaker link and needs deliberate attention.

sections.title: Main windows
sections.text:
Three windows carry the timing in this report. Each is a period of months, not a day.

The sorting-out stretch, October 2026 to January 2027. Jupiter moves into Leo on 31 October 2026 and Rahu into Capricorn on 5 December 2026. Offers and conversations can start, but the picture is not yet settled.

The clearer opening, June 2027 to October 2027. Saturn enters Aries on 3 June 2027 and meets the natal Venus three days later, and Jupiter returns to Leo on 26 June 2027. This is the best-supported time for a move.

The handover, November 2027 to March 2028. The Rahu sub-period ends and Saturn's long period begins on 10 January 2028, with Saturn back in Aries on 23 February 2028. This is a change of tone, not only of job.

units.theme: Authority built through service and steady effort
units.meaning: You do best where responsibility grows with competence and the work has a clear purpose: roles that help people or systems function. Effort here tends to be quiet and sustained.
units.manifestation: Most likely a salaried or institutional path in a skilled or advisory field, with growth by taking on more responsibility rather than by a sudden leap.
units.nuance: Both Saturn and Jupiter are strong: Saturn is in its own sign, and Jupiter is in the sign where it is strongest. The work drive is real.
units.counter: Saturn sits in the twelfth house with Rahu, so much of the effort goes on behind the scenes. Recognition and pay can arrive later than the work deserves.
units.watch: Being given responsibility before the title or the pay changes. That is this pattern at work, not a sign of being overlooked.
units.basis: Saturn, lord of the 1st and 12th, in its own sign in the 12th with Rahu (strength ratio 1.34). Jupiter, lord of the 2nd and 11th, in Cancer in the 6th (ratio 1.13). Mars, lord of the 10th, in the 4th (ratio 1.54).

units.theme: A work base tied to a place, a home or a structure
units.meaning: The ruler of the work house, Mars, sits in the house of home and roots. Work that gives you a stable base matters more than a title, and being settled supports your best work.
units.manifestation: A role that is anchored in one location or institution, or a move that keeps your home life steady, is more likely to suit you than constant travel or a loosely defined job.
units.nuance: Mars is the strongest planet in the chart by the engine's measure, so the drive and technical or practical skill are not in doubt.
units.counter: The same placement can bring friction at home or with a senior when the base feels threatened. Hasty decisions are the risk.
units.watch: How a possible move affects your home arrangements. If it unsettles them, the role is a poorer fit than it looks.
units.basis: Mars, lord of the 3rd and 10th, in Taurus in the 4th, strength ratio 1.54. The 10th house, Scorpio, holds no planet.

sections.title: The chapter you are in
sections.text:
You are in the long Jupiter chapter, which runs from January 2012 to January 2028. It is a period of learning, service and slow growth, and it ends in about fourteen months. Within it, the Rahu sub-period has run since August 2025 and ends on 10 January 2028. Rahu tends to make things restless and to open unfamiliar doors, which fits a person asking whether to change jobs.

The Mercury inner period, which runs to 10 January 2027, adds a note of paperwork, contracts and negotiation. Mercury is weak in this chart, so the details need checking twice.

Saturn is also in the last phase of what is traditionally called the seven-and-a-half-year period of Saturn, which ends when Saturn moves into Aries on 3 June 2027. Read it as a stretch that asks for patience, not as a bad sign in itself.

sections.title: The next two to three years

units.theme: Late 2026: look around, do not leap yet
units.meaning: The coming months open some doors and ask you to wait before walking through them. It is better used to find out what is possible than to commit.
units.manifestation: Approaches, conversations or a clearer sense of what you want are more likely than a finished move. An offer that arrives may have terms that are not yet clear.
units.timing: Jupiter enters Leo on 31 October 2026, the seventh house, and looks at both your first house and the house of gains. Rahu enters Capricorn on 5 December 2026. Both fall inside the sorting-out stretch from October 2026 to January 2027.
units.nuance: This is encouraging for opportunities arriving, and less so for signing quickly while the Mercury period still runs to January.
units.counter: Jupiter returns to Cancer on 25 January 2027, so any momentum from the first weeks does not carry on unchanged.
units.watch: An approach or an offer between November 2026 and January 2027 that is vague on role, pay or start date. Ask for the details in writing and give yourself time.
units.basis: Jupiter into Leo (7th) on 2026-10-31, aspecting the 1st and the 11th; Rahu into Capricorn (12th) on 2026-12-05; Mercury inner period in the Rahu sub-period of Jupiter ends 2027-01-10; Jupiter back into Cancer 2027-01-25 (local engine).

units.theme: Mid-2027: the clearer opening for a move
units.meaning: This is the best-supported stretch for changing role. Saturn moves into the third house, the house of effort and initiative, and Jupiter looks again at the gains.
units.manifestation: A change of employer or a move to a bigger version of your present role is likelier here than in late 2026. It is more likely to come through your own initiative and contacts than through a sudden offer.
units.timing: Saturn enters Aries on 3 June 2027 and meets the natal Venus on 6 June 2027. Jupiter returns to Leo on 26 June 2027, and stands opposite your ascendant on 3 October 2027. These agree on the months from June to October 2027.
units.nuance: Venus rules the houses of home and of luck for you, and Saturn meeting it is a supportive contact for a considered change.
units.counter: Saturn steps back into Pisces on 20 October 2027 and does not return to Aries until 23 February 2028. Some of the movement can be delayed or reversed, and a decision made in October may need revisiting.
units.watch: A concrete offer between June and October 2027 that fits the base described above and states pay and role clearly. If it comes, it is the main window working. If nothing comes, treat the stretch as preparation for early 2028.
units.basis: Saturn into Aries (3rd) 2027-06-03 and conjunct natal Venus 2027-06-06; Jupiter into Leo 2027-06-26 and opposite the natal ascendant 2027-10-03; Saturn back into Pisces 2027-10-20 and into Aries again 2028-02-23 (local engine).

units.theme: Early 2028: a change of long chapter
units.meaning: The Jupiter chapter ends and Saturn's begins. Saturn rules your first house, so this is a nineteen-year chapter about your own responsibility and standing, and work tends to become heavier, more structured and more durable.
units.manifestation: Whatever role you hold in early 2028 is likely to set the pattern for years, so choosing it deliberately in 2027 matters more than the exact month.
units.timing: The Rahu sub-period ends and Saturn's period begins on 10 January 2028; the Mars inner period before it starts on 20 November 2027. The handover window runs from November 2027 to March 2028.
units.nuance: A new long chapter changes the tone of work more than any single event does.
units.counter: Saturn's chapter asks for patience and steady work, not speed.
units.watch: A change in responsibility or scope between November 2027 and March 2028, with or without a change of employer.
units.basis: Jupiter–Rahu sub-period ends 2028-01-10 and the Saturn major period begins the same day; Mars inner period from 2027-11-20; Saturn into Aries 2028-02-23 (local engine).

units.theme: Income follows skill and service, but pay negotiation lags
units.meaning: Income comes from steady skilled or service work and from the people or institutions you serve. Windfalls are not the story.
units.manifestation: Gradual raises, better-paid roles over time, or income that grows as responsibility grows.
units.counter: Mercury, which sits in the house of earnings, is weak here. Negotiating pay, reading contract terms and asking for what the work is worth is the weaker link.
units.watch: Whether a new role brings a clear pay change. If the terms are vague, negotiate them rather than hoping they improve.
units.basis: Jupiter, lord of the 2nd and 11th, in Cancer in the 6th (ratio 1.13); Mercury, lord of the 5th and 8th, debilitated in Pisces in the 2nd (ratio 1.03).

units.theme: Should you change jobs this year?
units.meaning: The chart does not point to this year, which has only two months left. It does point to preparing now and to a better-supported stretch next year.
units.manifestation: Explore, update your work and contacts, and clarify what you want from a next role. If a good offer arrives before January, check its terms carefully before deciding.
units.timing: The sorting-out stretch from October 2026 to January 2027 favours looking around; the clearer opening in 2027 favours moving.
units.nuance: Staying is not a failure. The Jupiter chapter is one of service and steady growth, and a considered move later is more in keeping with it than a quick exit.
units.counter: Rahu in the twelfth house can make the present job feel more restrictive than it is. Restlessness alone is not a reason to move.
units.watch: Whether the wish to leave is about the role or about the time of year. If it is the role, the 2027 window is the place to act.
units.basis: Rahu in the 12th (restlessness, distance); Mercury inner period to 2027-01-10; Saturn and Jupiter ingresses of June 2027 (local engine).

uncertainty.birth_time: The birth time is taken as exact to the minute. Within the usual margin of 15 minutes the ascendant sign does not change: it would take about 67 minutes earlier or 31 later. Dasha dates also hold. The sign of the career divisional chart's ascendant would change within 8 minutes earlier or 2 later, so that chart is not used in this report.
engine_differences: Programs that count 360-day dasha years place the January 2028 change of period earlier; the sidereal-year dates are used here.
not_assessed: The career divisional chart (its ascendant is not stable within the birth-time margin).
Employers, salary figures and offer counts: a chart does not show these.
Health, family and relationships are outside the scope of this report.

practical_summary: Treat the coming three months as a time to look around and prepare, not to leave.
If you want a move, aim for the months between June and October 2027, and get role and pay stated clearly.
Choose your early-2028 role deliberately: it will set the tone for Saturn's long chapter.

appendix.method: Parashari, whole-sign houses from the sidereal ascendant; Vimshottari with 365.256-day years; transit sign changes calculated, not estimated.
sources: Mantreswara, Phaladeepika, chapter 26, verses 1–2: transits counted from the Moon, and the seven-and-a-half-year period of Saturn.
